note: Which ElevenLabs voice speaks for which character. The voiceId values stay empty until the owner has listened to auditions and chosen (M4 phase H). modelId must be the exact id of the model the owner picks in ElevenLabs; it is left empty rather than guessed.
_settingsNote: Sent explicitly with every line (voice_gen refuses settings without stability and similarity_boost). Set by the voice-and-sound-director on 2026-11-02 from the approved audition (round 3, 2026-11-01): similarity 0.8 for all; stability 0.5 for the lines not named in styleRules (praise, correct answers, greetings, goodbyes), and the styles on top: cheer 0.35 (celebrations), ceremony 0.45, thinking 0.55, ask 0.60 (questions, 'not yet' and listening lines), hint 0.65 (hints 1 and 2), hint3 0.70. style and speed are never sent to a v4 model, so a style is a stability only. A rule that starts with * matches the END of the voice id (voice_gen_lib.dart styleOf); every other rule matches the START. The first matching style wins, in the order written here. Reasons and the listening notes: docs/audio/b45-voicing-plan.md.
_priceNote: USD per 1,000 characters, list API prices (PLAN.md › costs), used only for the estimate that voice_gen plan prints. The owner's plan may differ; --price replaces them.
_rolesNote: narrators say every line of the app (a friend with a girl's voice borrows nitzi in the lessons, one with a boy's voice borrows hero-son). Every other character is a friend and says only ownLines, the lines at the edges of play, in its own voice; the app falls back to the narrator for any other line. voice_gen plan and generate give a friend only these lines. Reasons: docs/audio/b45-voicing-plan.md.
